summary: The boat-storage MVP is an unbranded template targeting marina and boat storage businesses in Ashtabula County, Ohio. Research identified 5 qualified leads including full-service marinas, yacht clubs, and combined marina/campground facilities. All leads offer seasonal slip rentals, winter storage options, and Lake Erie access. The Lake Erie boating market is significant, with Geneva Marina alone offering 379 slips and comprehensive marine services.

leads.name: Geneva Marina
leads.fit_rationale: Premier marina with 379 slips, transient docking, winter storage, trailer storage, marine shop (The Doc Shop), fuel dock, and boat ramp. Located at Geneva State Park with direct Lake Erie access. Offers comprehensive services including boat winterization, repairs, and certified Clean Marina status. High potential for digital booking and storage management.

leads.name: Harbor Yacht Club & Marina
leads.fit_rationale: Private marina with seasonal dock openings on Lake Erie. Located in Ashtabula Harbor with proximity to Geneva On The Lake. Targets boating enthusiasts and fishermen. Website indicates openness to new members and seasonal dock rentals, suggesting potential for improved booking and communication systems.

leads.name: Ashtabula Yacht Club
leads.fit_rationale: Established in 1924 with 150+ members and 125 docks accommodating boats 24'-50'. Features 35 ton travel lift and recent bulkhead improvements. Active sailing and racing program with social events. Located in protected Ashtabula Harbor. Historic organization that could benefit from modernized member management and dock reservation systems.

leads.name: North Coast Marina & Campgrounds
leads.fit_rationale: Combined marina and campground facility with dockage for 250 boats and 32 RV campsites (water/electric/sewer). Features pool, spas, pump-out station, and modern restrooms. Located on Ashtabula River with 20-minute cruise to Lake Erie. Markets itself as 'Lake Erie's Hottest Marina and Campground' - strong candidate for integrated booking platform covering both boat slips and campsites.

leads.name: A.R.U. Marina & Campgrounds
leads.fit_rationale: Offers seasonal dry boat storage, launch ramps, RV campsites, and boat docks on the Ashtabula River. Explicitly mentions 'seasonal dry boat storage complete with launch ramps' making it a direct fit for boat storage MVP. Active Facebook presence (365+ likes) indicates established customer base. Family-friendly fishing and camping destination.

issues: No logo or brand identity present
No color scheme or typography system
Missing contact information and trust signals
Page appears as raw HTML without CSS styling
Form layout is cramped and unstyled

site_improvements: Implement full CSS styling with responsive container layout
Add max-width container to prevent content stretching
Create branded header with marina-specific logo and navigation
Style form inputs with proper labels, spacing, and validation
Add footer with contact information, location, and business hours
Implement trust signals: testimonials, security badges, service guarantees
Add visual content: marina photos, Lake Erie imagery, facility tours
Create separate sections for different storage types (wet slip, dry storage, winter)
Add interactive map showing location on Ashtabula River/Lake Erie

aesthetics_and_layout_notes.color_scheme: Recommend nautical palette: navy blue, white, and accent colors (teal or coral) reflecting Lake Erie maritime environment
aesthetics_and_layout_notes.typography: Clean sans-serif for readability; consider serif accents for headings to convey tradition and trust
aesthetics_and_layout_notes.layout: Single-column centered layout with clear sections: Hero/Value Prop -> Storage Options -> Contact/Booking -> Amenities -> Footer
aesthetics_and_layout_notes.imagery: Lake Erie sunsets, marina aerial views, boat slips, satisfied customers, fishing charters, harbor scenes

customization_points: Swap logo and color scheme for each marina's brand
Customize storage options (wet slip vs dry storage vs winter)
Adjust amenities list to match each facility's offerings
Integrate specific location data and maps
Add member login for yacht clubs
Include charter boat partnerships where applicable
whitelabel_potential.regional_expansion: Template easily adaptable for other Lake Erie marinas in Northeast Ohio (Conneaut, Fairport Harbor, Cleveland) and Lake Ontario region

action_next: Contact Geneva Marina first (largest facility, most services, professional website indicates openness to technology). Follow with Harbor Yacht Club & Marina (explicitly seeking seasonal dock members).
